modules.description: Provides the shield; removing it leaves you unshielded.
Provides the Afterburner; removing it disables the dash.
Shows the health gauge on the HUD.
Shows damage numbers dealt to enemies.
Keeps the pilot alive. Removing it is fatal.
Enables A/S/D movement; without it only W and aim work.
Provides the Primary weapon; removing it disables firing.
Allows using the Q ability; removing it disables it.
Allows using the E ability; removing it disables it.
Allows using the F ability; removing it disables it.
Allows using the R ability; removing it disables it.
Primary damage +{damage.0.bonusPercent}%.
Primary projectiles pierce +{PrimaryWeapon.Projectile.Delivery.PierceCount} enemy.
Primary fire rate +%{Common.FireRate.bonusPercent}.
First {damage.0.openingShotCount} Primary shots in each magazine: damage x{damage.0.damageMultiplier}.
Increases Attack Power by +{Owner.AttackPower}.
Ability damage +%{Common.Damage.bonusPercent}.
Ability damage +%{Common.Damage.bonusPercent}; cooldown +%{Common.Cooldown.bonusPercent}.
Increases Armor by +{Owner.Armor}.
Increases Max Health by +{Owner.MaxHealth}.
Horizontal/vertical movement rating: +{Owner.MoveSpeedHorizontal} / +{Owner.MoveSpeedVertical}.
Horizontal movement rating: +{Owner.MoveSpeedHorizontal}.
Increases Ability Haste by +{Owner.AbilityHaste}.
Increases Energy Power by +{Owner.Energy.Power}.
Critical Chance +%{Owner.CriticalChance}.
Max Shield -%{Ship.Shield.Max.reductionPercent}; shield regen +%{Ship.Shield.Regen.bonusPercent}.
Max Shield +{Ship.Shield.Max}; shield regen +{Ship.Shield.Regen.bonusPercent}%; recharge delay {Ship.Shield.RechargeDelay} sec.
Increases Afterburner capacity by +{Ship.Afterburner.Capacity}.
On Offense use, Attack Speed +{Owner.AttackSpeed}% for {trigger.0.durationSeconds} sec.
Shield breaks: Primary +%{damage.0.bonusDamagePercent} Energy for {damage.0.activeDurationSeconds} sec; no crits.
Energy damage dealt: +{Owner.Energy.Power} Energy Power for {trigger.0.durationSeconds} sec.
When hit: movement speed x{trigger.0.movementSpeedMultiplier} for {trigger.0.durationSeconds} sec.
Target at %{damage.0.conditionPercent} health or less: damage x{damage.0.damageMultiplier}.

Utility module. In Wings/Core/Engine/Sensor: Offense/Defense/Movement/Utility cooldown -{cooldown.Module.Zone.Wings.reductionPercent}%. In Hull: all Q/E/F/R -{cooldown.Module.Zone.Hull.reductionPercent}%. No Nose effect.
Attack Power +{Owner.AttackPower}; Max Health -{Owner.MaxHealth.reductionPercent}%.
Attack Power +{Owner.AttackPower}; Energy Power +{Owner.Energy.Power}.
Critical damage +{Owner.CriticalDamage.percent}%; critical chance +{Owner.CriticalChance}%.
Each kill restores {action.0.amountPercent}% of Max Shield; excess is lost.
Each kill refunds {action.0.amountPercent}% of remaining Utility ability cooldowns. Excludes Primary.
Each kill refunds {action.0.amountPercent}% of remaining Offense ability cooldowns. Excludes Primary.
Each kill refunds {action.0.amountPercent}% of remaining Defense ability cooldowns. Excludes Primary.
Each kill refunds {action.0.amountPercent}% of remaining Movement ability cooldowns. Excludes Primary.
Gain +{owner.0.amount}% Attack Speed at 200 actual speed, plus the same amount per full 100 above it, including Afterburner. Zero below 200.
At {damage.0.conditionPercent}% hull health or less, take {damage.0.reductionPercent}% less damage.
Deal {damage.0.bonusPercent}% more damage to enemies with both Ignite and Cryo.
Primary hits deal {damage.0.bonusPercent}% more damage to enemies with no status effects.
Adjacent abilities add {damage.0.maxHealthDamagePercent}% of your Max Health to direct hits. Damage over time is excluded.
After Defense use, reflect {reflection.0.percent}% of shield damage as Energy for {reflection.0.durationSeconds}s. Cannot trigger modules.
Electric can reach 5 stacks: damage bonuses {electric.0.stack.0.percent}/{electric.0.stack.1.percent}/{electric.0.stack.2.percent}/{electric.0.stack.3.percent}/{electric.0.stack.4.percent}%.
At {freeze.0.threshold} Cryo, stop normal enemies moving and attacking for {freeze.0.durationSeconds}s; clear stacks. Per-target cooldown: {freeze.0.cooldownSeconds}s.
Each Primary shot bounces once for {ricochet.0.damagePercent}% hit damage: another enemy within {ricochet.0.range} units, or a random direction if none is nearby.

First Offense hit fires {salvo.0.projectileCount} guided missiles: {salvo.0.damagePercent}% hit damage each. Prefer different enemies; reuse targets when fewer are available. Speed {salvo.0.speed}, life {salvo.0.lifetime}s.

After Movement, drop a mine every {mine.0.spacing} units for {mine.0.windowSeconds}s: {mine.0.damage} + {mine.0.attackPowerPercent}% Attack Power Kinetic damage, {mine.0.radius} radius, {mine.0.fuseSeconds}s fuse. Max {mine.0.maxActive} active.
Above {shield.0.minimumSpeed} speed, your shield recharges from speed, including Afterburner: {shield.0.speedMultiplierAtMax}x normal rate at top speed.
Your shield never stops recharging, at {shield.0.continuousRatePercent}% of the normal rate.
Armor also protects your shield ({shield.0.armorSharePercent}% of its reduction).
Leave at least one slot empty to empower the remaining abilities: ability damage x{damage.0.damageMultiplier}.
Fly light, hit hard: +{damage.0.perEmptyCellPercent}% damage per empty cell.
Same speed in every direction. Thrust and top speed -{movement.0.thrustPenaltyPercent}%.
The farther you travel, the stronger you get: per {runCounter.0.unitsPerStack} units +{runCounter.0.damagePerStackPercent}% damage, +{runCounter.0.moveSpeedPerStackPercent}% speed.
When Thermal reaches 4 stacks, the target explodes once instead of taking Ignite damage over time: {thermalBurst.0.damagePercent}% of that stack's total 5 sec DoT; stacks are cleared.
While the target has {kinetic.0.stackThreshold} Kinetic stacks, your next direct hit consumes all of them, ignores the target's Armor completely and deals {kinetic.0.bonusPercent}% more damage.
Against a target whose hull MaxHealth is at least 1.5 times yours, your damage is increased by {damage.0.bonusPercent}%, growing by {damage.0.ratioSlope} for every extra time the ratio.

Reach top speed and your shots go sonic. After {sonic.0.holdSeconds} sec of uninterrupted flight above {sonic.0.speedPercent}% of max speed, the ship goes sonic: Primary projectiles travel {sonic.0.primarySpeedMultiplier} times as fast, pierce {sonic.0.primaryPierceBonus} more target and deal {sonic.0.primaryDamagePercent}% more damage. Ends when you slow down.

Each enemy killed by the adjacent Q/E/F/R ability permanently adds {runCounter.0.damagePerStackPercent}% damage for the run (elite {runCounter.0.elitePercent}%, boss {runCounter.0.bossPercent}%). Stacks stay with the module, so moving it next to another ability moves the bonus with it.

Burst damage adds {ownerBurst.0.energyPowerCoefficient} x Energy Power. Each enemy that dies within {ownerBurst.0.chargeRadius} units of you charges the star. At {ownerBurst.0.chargeKills} charges it explodes in a Thermal blast within {ownerBurst.0.radius} units that deals {ownerBurst.0.damage} damage and applies {ownerBurst.0.igniteStacks} Ignite stacks to each enemy hit, and the charges reset.
Adjacent abilities gain extra charges: +1 at level 1, +2 at level 2, +3 at level 3. Bigger sizes reach more adjacent abilities (1, 2 or 3). Cooldowns are unchanged.
Attack Power and Energy Power both become the higher of the two, plus {owner.0.amount}. The bonus never feeds back into the comparison.
Gain Armor equal to {owner.0.amountPercent}% of your Max Health. Health and Armor are not spent.

Each other installed main module adds to its family's stats: Offense AP and EP +{familyStat.0.perModule}, Defense Max Health +{familyStat.2.perModule}, Primary fire rate +{familyStat.3.perModulePercent}%, Movement rating +{familyStat.4.perModule}, Utility cooldown recovery +{familyStat.6.perModulePercent}%.

Horizontal and vertical movement rating +{Owner.MoveSpeedHorizontal}, plus {familyStat.0.perModule} for each other installed Movement module. On Movement ability use, this module's total rating is doubled for {trigger.0.durationSeconds} sec; re-use refreshes it.
Defense ability use restores {action.0.amountPercent}% of Max Shield; cannot exceed maximum.
Defense ability use grants Armor +25 for 4 seconds; refreshes without stacking.
Armor grants {owner.0.amountPercent}% of its value to the higher of Attack Power and Energy Power (ties: Attack Power).
Defense ability use grants a temporary shield layer equal to {action.0.amountPercent}% of Max Shield; decays over {action.0.durationSeconds}s. Repeat use refreshes without stacking.
Primary hits add one stack to the most-stacked existing damage status; {statusPrimer.0.cooldownSeconds}s cooldown per target. No effect without a status.
Each Defense use permanently grants {runCounter.0.armorPerStack} Armor this run, up to {runCounter.0.armorCap}.

After a Movement use, sample peak speed for {speedLance.0.sampleSeconds}s and fire a piercing Energy lance: damage = speed x{speedLance.0.speedDamageCoefficient}. Range {speedLance.0.range}, speed {speedLance.0.projectileSpeed}/s. Full damage, once per target.
Utility use deals {annularBurst.0.energyPowerPercent}% Energy Power as Energy damage in the {annularBurst.0.innerRadius}-{annularBurst.0.outerRadius} ring. No damage inside, no push.
Each {owner.0.goldPerArmor} Gold currently held grants one Armor, up to {owner.0.maximumAmount}.
Normal shield capacity is split equally between independent front and rear pools. An empty struck pool exposes the hull. Recharge fills the lower pool first; temporary shield is shared.
